claims.claim_text: Indexed Staff Sergeant William S. Mierzejewski is a high-confidence match to the OSS serviceman documented in Yugoslavia.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The distinctive full name and staff-sergeant rank align between the index and an IPN study naming OSS personnel in special operations during 1944.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from a distinctive exact name, matching grade, OSS identification, and specific 1944 operational context.
claims.temporal_assessment: Identity evidence concerns wartime OSS activity; it does not establish pre-OSS employment.
claims.match_notes: No employer or earlier occupation is inferred from the operational history.

claims.claim_text: Indexed Amelio Migliaccio has a high-confidence match to an official Army entry recorded as Amelie Migliaccio.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The protected identifier and surname align; the given-name difference is retained as a variant rather than silently corrected.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from a nonshared protected-identifier match and close full-name agreement.
claims.temporal_assessment: Identity context only; the Army record does not establish a named employer or OSS-entry chronology.
claims.match_notes: Official bulk record ordinal 3768779; protected identifier and Army occupation code are omitted publicly.

claims.claim_text: Rafael P. Miettunen cannot yet be resolved because a Rafael P. Mettuhen row in another box repeats the same protected identifier.

research_attempts.query_text: William S Mierzejewski; OSS; Office of Strategic Services; staff sergeant; employer; occupation; obituary; Polish archive
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Genealogy and namesake results lacked rank and OSS context; no source named a predecessor employer.
research_attempts.research_notes: NARA context, an IPN institutional history, LoC, exact-name OSS and employment searches, and a cohort CIA access check established identity but no pre-OSS employer. CIA access was unavailable and was not counted as a negative result.
research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 522 for pre-service occupation and employer.

research_attempts.research_notes: NARA context, LoC, exact-name and employment searches, and a cohort CIA access check leave a terminal online identity conflict pending archival review.
research_attempts.next_action: Compare Boxes 520 and 522.

research_attempts.next_action: Inspect Box 522 for spelling and pre-Army employment.
